content.title: About
content.content: Decaffeinated cappuccino is a beverage made from espresso brewed with decaf coffee beans, combined with hot milk and milk foam. It retains the characteristic flavor notes of a traditional cappuccino while lacking the stimulating effect of caffeine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water‑process or CO₂ extraction, preserving most aromatic compounds.
Cappuccino without caffeine is often chosen by people sensitive to caffeine but who still want the coffee experience.
Traditional Italian cappuccino consists of equal parts espresso, hot milk, and milk foam.
The foam creates microscopic bubbles that trap aromatic oils, enhancing flavor.
In some countries, decaf coffee drinks are sold only in specialty cafés.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Decaf beans retain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Coffee stimulates gastric secretions, which can aid digestion even without caffeine.

items.title: Low caffeine content
items.content: Suitable for individuals with caffeine sensitivity, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Source of magnesium and potassium
items.content: These minerals are important for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Mood‑enhancing aroma
items.content: The coffee aroma can have a calming effect and improve overall well‑being.

items.title: Residual caffeine
items.content: Even after decaffeination, a small amount of caffeine may remain.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee can irritate the stomach in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: The milk foam makes the drink unsuitable for those with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Additives and flavorings
items.content: Some decaf blends may contain artificial flavorings that not everyone tolerates.

content.title: How to Enjoy
content.content: Serve decaf cappuccino hot, immediately after preparation to preserve the creamy foam. Optionally sprinkle cinnamon, cocoa powder, or a small amount of sugar to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep decaffeinated coffee beans in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. Milk should be stored in the refrigerator and used within 2–3 days.
